stories.title: Peer review is overwhelmed—can it survive in the AI era?

The article questions the long-term viability and sustainability of traditional peer review in the age of advanced AI research.

stories.title: Judge rules Meta caused "public nuisance" and must fund mental health treatment

This case represents a significant legal action holding a major tech company accountable for societal impacts of its products.

stories.title: CreativeInstruct: Scalably Teaching LLMs to Balance Quality, Creativity, and Diversity
stories.author: Elias Stengel-Eskin
bullet_points: CreativeInstruct is a new scalable instruction-tuning method designed to address a key LLM limitation.
Traditional post-training often sacrifices output diversity and creativity for improved quality.
The method aims to balance the high quality of fine-tuned models with the creative diversity of base models.

stories.title: PsychoAgent: An Affect-Sensitive Cognitive Architecture for Conflict-Aware Memory in LLM Agents
stories.author: Abdol-Hossein Vahabie
bullet_points: Introduces PsychoAgent, a novel cognitive architecture designed for LLM agents.
It addresses the limitation of topical-only memory retrieval by incorporating affective significance and unresolved conflict.
The architecture separates factual and affective memory, using a conflict-aware executive controller to integrate them.

stories.title: Fisher-R1: Training LLM Agents for Reliable Hypothesis Testing
stories.author: James Zou
bullet_points: LLM agents are being used to automate complex scientific tasks like hypothesis testing.
The research identifies a critical failure mode where LLMs make subtle inferential errors, leading to incorrect scientific conclusions.
Current evaluation benchmarks are insufficient because they do not adequately test the statistical validity of LLM outputs (e.g., p-values).

stories.title: Diffusion LLMs as Targets and Adversaries: Mechanistic Safety Exploits
stories.author: Jérémie Decouchant
bullet_points: The research investigates Diffusion Large Language Models (DLLMs), which use iterative denoising instead of standard next-token prediction.
The study exposes mechanistic vulnerabilities in the safety alignment mechanisms of DLLMs by treating them as both targets and adversaries.
Findings indicate that safety alignment in DLLMs is sparse and transferable, even when initialized from autoregressive models.

stories.title: Beyond Post-Hoc Temperature Scaling: Bilevel Optimization for LLM Calibration
stories.author: Bojian Hou
bullet_points: Addresses the issue of LLM overconfidence and poor calibration resulting from preference alignment.
Proposes a novel approach using bilevel optimization to modify model parameters during training, moving beyond traditional post-hoc methods.
The calibration objective maximizes the entropy of predictive distributions to discourage overly concentrated predictions.

stories.title: CreativeInstruct: Scalably Teaching LLMs to Balance Quality, Creativity, and Diversity
stories.author: Elias Stengel-Eskin
bullet_points: Addresses a core LLM challenge: post-training often reduces output diversity and creativity.
Introduces 'CreativeInstruct,' a scalable instruction-tuning method designed to mitigate this trade-off.
Aims to balance the high quality of fine-tuned models with the creative potential of base models.

stories.title: Meta Muse Glimmer – open weights 30B local coding model
stories.author: riordan
bullet_points: Introduction of 'Meta Muse Glimmer,' a new open-weights coding model.
The model boasts a substantial 30 billion parameter size.
Its key feature is suitability for local deployment, promoting accessibility.

It features built-in support for Ollama, facilitating local LLM execution.

stories.title: Subagents and web search in Claude Code
stories.author: unknown
bullet_points: Ollama has integrated support for subagents within Claude Code.

This enhances the capabilities of local LLM environments by integrating advanced AI features.

stories.title: Europe's free satellite service just made it easier to track wildfires
stories.author: Jeremy Hsu
bullet_points: Copernicus Browser, a free European satellite service, has been updated to include wildfire visualization.
The enhancement aims to improve tracking and monitoring capabilities during a record wildfire season.
This represents a practical application of satellite data for environmental monitoring and disaster response.

stories.title: CoinRAG: Contextualized Information Nugget KV Cache Reuse for Long-Context RAG
stories.author: Tao Yang
bullet_points: Introduces CoinRAG, a new optimization technique for Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG).
Addresses the issue of information redundancy and noise in large, coarse-grained retrieved contexts.
Aims to maximize RAG accuracy while maintaining low prefill latency through contextualized KV cache reuse.

stories.title: Interaction Creates Dynamical AI Behavior Absent in Isolation
stories.author: Neil F Johnson
bullet_points: The research explores emergent, non-isolated AI behavior when agents interact, specifically focusing on hierarchical interactions (e.g., 'boss' and 'subordinate' AIs).
Interaction can drive subordinate AIs into novel, 'alien' behavioral states that they would not exhibit when operating alone.
The findings suggest new avenues for applying concepts from out-of-equilibrium Physics to the study of complex AI systems.

stories.title: SkillProx: Self-Evolving Agent Skills via Proximal Textual Gradient Descent
stories.author: Yike Guo
bullet_points: Introduces 'SkillProx,' a method for self-evolving LLM agent skills using Proximal Textual Gradient Descent.
Addresses limitations in current skill-based LLM agents, specifically the lack of explicit outcome feedback and dedicated deletion mechanisms.
Focuses on refining lightweight, reusable textual skills through iterative execution and trajectory-guided text-space updates.

stories.title: Taxonomy-Driven Analysis of Open-Source AI Risk Mitigation Tools
stories.author: Dimitar Trajanov
bullet_points: The rapid enterprise adoption of LLMs is creating significant, hard-to-scale operational, security, and governance risks.
The current tooling landscape for AI risk mitigation (evaluation, adversarial testing, guardrails) is highly fragmented.
The research aims to provide a taxonomy to better organize and analyze the existing, task-specific open-source AI risk mitigation tools.

stories.title: Blast Radius
stories.author: Hope Mogale
bullet_points: Introduces 'Blast Radius,' a predictive memory management layer for agentic coding to address token waste and affordability issues.
Utilizes coupled context and code channels to estimate the reach of incoming prompts.
Features mechanisms like NECROPHORESIS for reversible context eviction and RDM for managing repetitive transcripts.

stories.title: MirrorWorld: Taming Video Diffusion Models for Mirror Reflection Generation
stories.author: Rynson W. H. Lau
bullet_points: The research addresses a key limitation in Video Diffusion Models (VDMs): generating consistent mirror reflections.
Existing VDMs struggle because they lack specific mechanisms to model the scene-to-mirror relationship.
The work proposes a method, 'MirrorWorld,' to tackle the dual challenges of accurate reflection content and spatial consistency.

stories.title: CoinRAG: Contextualized Information Nugget KV Cache Reuse for Long-Context RAG
stories.author: Tao Yang
bullet_points: Introduces CoinRAG, a novel optimization technique for Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) systems.
Addresses the inefficiency of processing long, redundant contexts in RAG by optimizing KV cache reuse at a finer granularity.
Aims to improve the Pareto frontier between low prefill latency and high accuracy in long-context RAG applications.

stories.title: RIS-Aided mmWave Localization Under Cross-Link Interference via Beam-Domain ML Fingerprinting
stories.author: Muhammad Ali Babar Abbasi
bullet_points: Addresses critical user equipment (UE) localization challenges in 6G mmWave networks utilizing Reconfigurable Intelligent Surfaces (RIS).
Proposes a novel beam-domain fingerprinting framework to determine UE azimuth angle and range.
Key advantage is achieving localization without the need for explicit Channel State Information (CSI).

stories.title: Cloud-Boosted Low-Compute Multi-Channel Speech Enhancement
stories.author: Buye Xu
bullet_points: Addresses the challenge of achieving low-latency, low-compute speech enhancement for wearable devices.
Proposes a new collaborative framework to improve edge model performance by leveraging server-side models.
Combines three specific techniques to overcome limitations seen in previous knowledge boosting approaches for speech enhancement.

stories.title: Beyond Myopic World Models: Long-Horizon End-to-End Training for Direct Future Prediction
stories.author: Yubei Chen
bullet_points: The paper addresses a fundamental limitation in current world models: they are typically trained using short-term, local prediction objectives.
This local training creates a mismatch with the goal of long-horizon future prediction, as errors propagate unpredictably over long trajectories.
The research proposes a new approach for end-to-end training to enable more accurate and robust direct future prediction over extended time scales.

stories.title: GeoBenchLLM: A Comprehensive Benchmark for Evaluating LLMs on Geo-Related Tasks
stories.author: Lynda Tamine
bullet_points: Introduces GeoBenchLLM, a new comprehensive benchmark specifically designed for evaluating LLMs on geo-related tasks.
Addresses the limitation of current LLM studies which often treat geodata in a homogeneous setting, hindering generalization insights.
The benchmark utilizes twelve diverse, publicly available datasets to test LLMs' geo-spatial and temporal understanding.

stories.title: CoinRAG: Contextualized Information Nugget KV Cache Reuse for Long-Context RAG
stories.author: Tao Yang
bullet_points: Introduces CoinRAG, a new method to optimize Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) systems.
Addresses the inefficiency of processing long, redundant contexts in RAG by focusing on KV cache reuse.
Aims to improve accuracy and efficiency while maintaining low prefill latency in long-context scenarios.

stories.title: SkillProx: Self-Evolving Agent Skills via Proximal Textual Gradient Descent
stories.author: Yike Guo
bullet_points: Introduces SkillProx, a method for self-evolving LLM agent skills using Proximal Textual Gradient Descent.
Addresses limitations in current agent frameworks by providing explicit diagnosis-outcome feedback for skill refinement.
Proposes a dedicated mechanism for skill deletion, moving beyond generic text editing operations.

stories.title: PsychoAgent: An Affect-Sensitive Cognitive Architecture for Conflict-Aware Memory in LLM Agents
stories.author: Abdol-Hossein Vahabie
bullet_points: Introduces PsychoAgent, a new cognitive architecture for LLM agents designed to mimic human-like memory retrieval.
The architecture separates factual memory from affective (emotionally significant) memory.
It uses a conflict-aware executive controller to integrate both memory types, prioritizing emotionally salient traces alongside topical relevance.

stories.title: SABRE: Scalable and Automated Benchmarking of VLMs under Stress
stories.author: Jiawei Zhou
bullet_points: Addresses the lagging development of benchmarks for rapidly improving Vision-Language Models (VLMs).
Introduces SABRE, a scalable and automated pipeline for creating VLM stress tests.
SABRE converts high-level Markdown Task Designs into structured specifications, images, and Q&A pairs.

stories.title: ResidencyRL: Reinforcement Learning in Simulated Clinical Environments
stories.author: Lin Yang
bullet_points: The research introduces ResidencyRL, a system using Reinforcement Learning (RL) to simulate clinical environments.
It addresses the gap where current Large Language Models (LLMs) perform well on static benchmarks but lack the ability to optimize complex, dynamic clinical reasoning.
The goal is to model the process of clinical expertise development, which occurs through iterative patient encounters and feedback during residency.

stories.title: GeoBenchLLM: A Comprehensive Benchmark for Evaluating LLMs on Geo-Related Tasks
stories.author: Lynda Tamine
bullet_points: Introduces GeoBenchLLM, a new comprehensive benchmark specifically designed to evaluate LLMs on geo-related tasks.
Addresses the limitation of existing studies by testing LLMs in a heterogeneous setting using twelve diverse public datasets.
Focuses on probing LLMs' capabilities in geo-spatial and temporal understanding.

stories.title: LitTraceQA: A Benchmark for Multi-Stage Grounding and Verification in Scientific Question Answering
stories.author: Krzysztof Czarnecki
bullet_points: Introduces LitTraceQA, a new benchmark specifically designed for scientific question answering.
Addresses the critical need for models to move beyond fluent generation to accurate evidence grounding in scientific literature.
Focuses on the multi-stage task of identifying relevant papers, locating concrete evidence, and ensuring response faithfulness.

These sandboxes offer disposable and isolated environments for running AI workloads.
This suggests a focus on improving the safety and management of autonomous AI systems.
